title: MCT4-Mediated Metabolic Reprogramming in Tumor-Associated Macrophages Promotes Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression.
snippet: RMonocarboxylate transporter protein 4 (MCT4), encoded by thegene, mediates lactate efflux into the extracellular microenvironment.
